mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE ancestors AS ( SELECT m.id, m.name, m.gender, m.birth_year, m.death_year, m.bio, m.generation, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS parent_id, 0 AS depth, ARRAY[m.id] AS visited FROM members m WHERE m.id = #{memberId} UNION ALL SELECT parent.id, parent.name, parent.gender, parent.birth_year, parent.death_year, parent.bio, parent.generation, r.to_member_id AS parent_id, a.depth + 1, a.visited || parent.id FROM ancestors a JOIN relations r ON r.to_member_id = a.id AND r.relation_type IN ('PARENT_SON','PARENT_DAUGHTER','MOTHER_SON','MOTHER_DAUGHTER') JOIN members parent ON parent.id = r.from_member_id WHERE a.depth < 100 AND NOT (parent.id = ANY(a.visited)) ) SELECT DISTINCT id, name, gender, birth_year, death_year, bio, generation, parent_id, depth FROM ancestors ORDER BY depth;

WITH RECURSIVE descendants AS ( SELECT m.id, m.name, m.gender, m.birth_year, m.death_year, m.bio, m.generation, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS parent_id, 0 AS depth, ARRAY[m.id] AS visited FROM members m WHERE m.id = #{memberId} UNION ALL SELECT child.id, child.name, child.gender, child.birth_year, child.death_year, child.bio, child.generation, r.from_member_id AS parent_id, d.depth + 1, d.visited || child.id FROM descendants d JOIN relations r ON r.from_member_id = d.id AND r.relation_type IN ('PARENT_SON','PARENT_DAUGHTER','MOTHER_SON','MOTHER_DAUGHTER') JOIN members child ON child.id = r.to_member_id WHERE d.depth < #{maxDepth} AND NOT (child.id = ANY(d.visited)) ) SELECT DISTINCT id, name, gender, birth_year, death_year, bio, generation, parent_id, depth FROM descendants ORDER BY depth, id;

WITH RECURSIVE edges AS ( SELECT from_member_id, to_member_id, relation_type FROM relations WHERE family_id = #{familyId} UNION SELECT to_member_id AS from_member_id, from_member_id AS to_member_id, relation_type FROM relations WHERE family_id = #{familyId} ), path AS ( SELECT e.from_member_id, e.to_member_id, e.relation_type, ARRAY[e.from_member_id, e.to_member_id] AS visited, ARRAY[e.from_member_id::TEXT || '->' || e.to_member_id::TEXT] AS path_edges FROM edges e WHERE e.from_member_id = #{memberAId} UNION ALL SELECT e.from_member_id, e.to_member_id, e.relation_type, p.visited || e.to_member_id, p.path_edges || (e.from_member_id::TEXT || '->' || e.to_member_id::TEXT) FROM edges e JOIN path p ON e.from_member_id = p.to_member_id WHERE NOT (e.to_member_id = ANY(p.visited)) AND array_length(p.visited, 1) < 20 ) SELECT from_member_id, to_member_id, relation_type, path_edges FROM path WHERE to_member_id = #{memberBId} ORDER BY array_length(path_edges, 1) LIMIT 1;
